rubrics.justification: Describes plausible blastocyst features (blastocoel, ICM, TE, zona) and appropriately questions whether the image fully matches 3AB, but repeatedly speculates beyond what can be confidently verified from a single image and is somewhat inconsistent about exact grading.

Integrates age, tubal factor, prior ectopic/miscarriage, semen quality, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis; misses AMH as unavailable and could better distinguish embryo-driven vs uterine/tubal risks.

Overall logic is clear: moderate embryo quality tempered by favorable patient factors leads to intermediate implantation odds. Minor issues include some wavering on morphology and broad statements about day-4 kinetics and outcome estimates.

Mostly consistent with IVF practice (single embryo transfer counseling, hydrosalpinx concern, luteal support, ectopic follow-up), but there are some deviations/overreaches such as suggesting double embryo transfer and loosely framed PGT-A/freeze-all recommendations without strong case-specific indication.

Provides practical next steps: proceed if no hydrosalpinx, standard luteal support, lifestyle optimization, beta-hCG and early ultrasound, and future evaluation of tubal/cavity factors. Useful, though some recommendations remain somewhat generic.
